comparator.sourceNotes: Checked 2026-11-13. Current BA-GEN retains 31 nonduplicated components totalling 173 EC: year1=60, year2=60, supported year3=53. Zero-credit children, exchange-only AWV and pre-master introductions are excluded. LPV3 remains null in EN/NL, and AWV3 has 3 EC metadata without descriptions; a forward-year BA-GEN query returns the same current bytes. Current LPV2 requires LPV1 and explicitly develops consultation, physical examination, communication, health promotion, reflection and professional behaviour. Retain its recorded LPV3 progression finding: positive LPV2 and at least two of Abdomen, Locomotion and Thorax/Kidney. Current general year-three text says no half-minor admission requirement beyond BSA and placement by seniority/credits, but is explicitly marked as awaiting the revised programme. The freshly retrieved 2025–2026 OER is contextual: article8.3 limits validity to one academic year; appendix defines a distributed final work including VGT3/CAT/LPV3 and lists LPV3=7, whereas the current general guide still mentions the half-minor report. Do not silently adopt the old 7 EC, endpoint, choice approval or progression framework for 2026–2027. Older minor guidance is BW-specific in relevant thresholds. The former regulations URL now returns404 and is preserved in original evidence, not treated as current authority. Use the human-readable official English programme page as primary source; retain formal/history and current guide as internal sources. All 30 interest judgments and 27 current-UCR contribution findings remain relevant, including description-only courses; the feasible 24-course research response is provisional, not an active comparison or clinical qualification.

exception.reason: Confirm the current LPV3 (30136LPV1Y) credits and assessment, AWV3/final-work specification, and applicable half-minor and progression conditions, or an explicit authoritative cohort bridge. Current English and Dutch LPV3 requests return JSON null; AWV3 confirms 3 EC but has no content or assessment description. Current BA-GEN year-three text is still marked as awaiting the revised programme and gives a distributed endpoint that differs from the 2025–2026 formal Curriculum 2023 definition. The retrieved 2025–2026 OER explicitly lasts one academic year. Its 2026 theme footnote is not general renewal; older minor guidance concerns 2025–2026 and includes Biomedical Sciences rules that cannot be applied to Medicine. Current general BSA/placement information and LPV2-to-LPV3 entry findings survive, but do not establish every missing current endpoint and choice condition. Preserve 173 supported EC; do not assign the remaining 7 EC to LPV3 by subtraction. No no-match is inferred.

audience.programmeDescription: Leiden Medicine combines the biological basis of health and disease with clinical problems, patient communication, physical examination, scientific inquiry and professional development. Supervised care experience and longitudinal skills teaching connect medical knowledge with patient care.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The displayed 173 EC allocation is incomplete. The current third-year professional-skills specification, final-work requirements and applicable progression and half-minor conditions still need confirmation. UCR offers biomedical, clinical-case, psychological and research study that is being assessed against this degree. A complete comparison with UCR remains unfinished; no UCR alternative is shown here.

curriculum.limitation: Published credits account for 173 of 180 EC. The first two years contribute 120 EC, with 53 EC of supported third-year units and selection space shown here. Seven EC remain unallocated. This is a partial credit inventory, not a certified complete pathway. Second-year professional skills requires LPV1; entry into LPV3 requires a positive LPV2 assessment and at least two specified second-year clinical blocks. LPV3 credits and assessment, the final-work requirements and half-minor conditions remain under review.

componentNotes.y1-3011zgs00y: Compulsory 3 EC care placement with patient communication, supervised care activities, reflection and assessment.
componentNotes.y1-3011lpv20y: Compulsory 8 EC skills line includes patient history, clinical reasoning, physical-examination practice, basic life support, communication and professional development.
componentNotes.y2-30128lpv0y: Compulsory 5 EC skills line requires LPV1. Practice groups, reflection and physical-examination and consultation assessments are required.
componentNotes.y3-3013awv20y: The current catalogue confirms 3 EC but does not supply the content or assessment specification needed to verify its final-work role.
componentNotes.y3-half-minor: A 15 EC selection from the faculty half-minor menu. This is not unrestricted free choice; entry and approval conditions remain to be verified.
